projects.title: Subliminal: Connect Four clone
projects.description:
Subliminal is a software project written for an assignment in Artificial Intelligence. It is essentially a clone of Connect Four written in C# that uses WPF for its GUI. It is designed for human vs. player sessions where the look-ahead of the computer can be adjusted from 1-7 moves ahead.

The algorithm used to decide on the next player move is a recursive alpha-beta pruning implementation. It returns both the column and score index of best selection. At each depth, it calculates the state heuristic for each of the possible next states and first expands the state with the best heuristic depending on whether it’s currently max's or min’s turn. It enumerates all possible moves while skipping unnecessary states.

projects.title: BFForever: Open-source library for BandFuse
projects.description: Actively developed open-source .NET library for managing various game files for "BandFuse: Rock Legends" released for Xbox 360. The library can be used for creating custom songs which can be played on hacked Xbox 360 consoles.
